description: This file contains unit tests for the HibernateDiagnosisDAO class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing diagnosis data access operations using JUnit 5.

classes.name: HibernateDiagnosisDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing Diagnosis data access object (DAO) behaviors, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for integration testing with database

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by executing a specific dataset XML before each test

methods.name: shouldSaveDiagnosis
methods.description: Tests saving a Diagnosis object and verifies retrieval and field integrity

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a Diagnosis by its UUID

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosisById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a Diagnosis by its internal ID

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithFromDate
methods.description: Tests fetching active diagnoses after a specific date for a patient

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithDifferentFromDate
methods.description: Tests fetching active diagnoses using a different 'from' date

methods.name: shouldGetActiveDiagnosesWithoutFromDate
methods.description: Tests fetching all active diagnoses without specifying a date

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses linked to a specific encounter not marked as primary or confirmed

methods.name: shouldGetPrimaryDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses marked as primary for a specific encounter

methods.name: shouldGetConfirmedDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses marked as confirmed for a specific encounter

methods.name: shouldGetDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses linked to a specific visit, excluding primary and confirmed diagnoses

methods.name: shouldGetPrimaryDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves primary diagnoses associated with a visit

methods.name: shouldGetConfirmedDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves confirmed diagnoses associated with a visit

methods.name: shouldDeleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Tests deletion of a diagnosis and verifies it is no longer retrievable
